Professional Experience  
During my tenure as a Data Analyst Intern at AdVerve Interactive in 2022, I supported the team by refining data pipelines for ad campaign performance tracking. This involved automating data extraction from third-party tools using Python scripts and structuring datasets for analysis. My role expanded in 2023 when I transitioned to a Junior Data Engineer position, where I contributed to building scalable ETL workflows using Apache Spark. These pipelines processed terabytes of user interaction data daily, ensuring timely insights for client reporting. I also collaborated on integrating Snowflake as a data warehouse, optimizing query performance through schema design and partitioning strategies. My work with Docker enabled the creation of reproducible environments for data processing tasks, reducing deployment friction.  

Education  
Bachelor of Computer Science, University of Technology, Sydney (2022–2023). Focused on database systems, distributed computing, and data analytics. Graduated with a weighted average of 7.8/10, completing projects that involved designing ETL processes and deploying data models for business intelligence.  

Technical Skills  
Apache Spark: Developed fault-tolerant data processing pipelines to aggregate ad impressions and clicks, leveraging distributed computing for sub-5-second query latency. Apache Kafka: Integrated real-time user engagement data streams into existing architectures, ensuring low-latency ingestion for dynamic reporting dashboards. Data Warehousing: Architected Snowflake schemas to consolidate campaign metrics from 12+ sources, improving query efficiency by 40% through materialized views and partitioning. Data Modeling: Designed dimensional models for ad performance analytics, enabling cross-dimensional analysis of campaign ROI and user segmentation. ETL Pipeline Design: Automated data flow from CSV and JSON sources to Snowflake using Airflow, reducing manual intervention by 60%. Python: Scripted data validation routines and built lightweight web interfaces for internal data exploration using Flask. Docker: Containerized data processing jobs to ensure consistency across development and production environments.  

Projects  
1. **Ad Campaign Performance Dashboard**: Built a real-time dashboard using Power BI, integrating data from Kafka streams and Snowflake. The solution reduced report generation time by 35% and provided actionable insights for client campaign optimization.  
2. **User Behavior Analytics Pipeline**: Designed an ETL workflow to process 50M+ user interactions monthly, using Spark for batch processing and Kafka for streaming. The pipeline supported A/B testing frameworks for ad creatives.  
3. **Data Quality Monitoring Tool**: Developed a Python-based tool to validate data integrity across pipelines, flagging anomalies in 98% of cases before downstream processing.  

Certifications  
Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer (2023) – Validated expertise in cloud-based data solutions and pipeline orchestration.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Hindi (native), SQL (proficient), Python (intermediate).
